main_text.p: מַעַּ Hebr. Vacillavit, Lapsus est, Nutavit. Hinc רַגְלָא מִיעַר Pes luxatus, Prov.25.19.
מָעַךְ Chald. Comprimere, Participip. וּמָעִיךְ Et compressus, contusus, Levit.22.24. in Jonath. Heb. מָעִיךְ.
מָעִיךְ Chal. Ornamentum pectoris muliebre. Plural. מָעוּכְיָא, Num.31.50. in Targ. Hierof. In Jonathane & Onkelo scribitur pern in medio.
מַעַל מְעִילָא, מְעִיל Ch. Pallium, Tunica, Toga, ut Heb. Plur. מְעִילִין.
מִפִּים Chal. Memphis, civitas Ægypti, Hebr. נוֹף Jesa.19.13.

S.Posse, Valere, Ithpeh. יִתְמַצֵּא Ut valeatis viribus, robore, juxta Regia. Tremell. Ut inveniamini validi, ad Eph. 6.16. Sed מצא ibi non videtur esse numeri pluralis, cùm puncta diacritica ascripta non habeat: ac ita prior expositio præferenda. Chaldæis verò אִתְמְצִי est Exprimi, ut Heb. נִמְצָה, Futur. וִיתְמְצִי דְמִיר Et exprimetur sanguis ejus, Levit. 1.15. in Onk. In Targ. Hierof. est יִמְצִי per syncopam: Item extitit, Superfuit, ut Heb. נִמְצָא Jobi 4.12. Reg. reddunt, Redundavit.
מְצַב מְצוּג Ch. Propago vitis, Plur. תְּלָתֵי מְצוֹנְיָא Tres propagines, Gen.40.12. in Jon.
מְצָרְ מְצַרְתָּא מְצִרְתָּא Chal. Munitio, Arx, Propugnaculum. Plural. מְצַרְתָּא, מְצָרִין Ezech.33.27. & masc. מְצָרְיָא Ezech. 19. 9. construct. מְצָרִי, Ezech. 7. 6. Vide

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-looking words are printed Hebrew; several Hebrew forms are uncertain due to scan resolution and are transcribed as best possible, not verified. The page ends with the catchword-like word "Vide" at the lower right, which is part of the last line.
